The build passes now. Exit code is 0.

**Two real bugs, both from the bump.** Both were in the link stage, and they were sequential — the first hid the second.

1. `src/core/options.js:7` — the bundler renamed the option `retries` to `retryCount`. This call site still read `options.retries`, so it was `undefined` and `.toFixed()` threw. Fix: read `retryCount` first, fall back to `retries`, and default to `0` if neither is set.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — the new config loader leaves an unset flag as `undefined`, not `false`. The strict check threw on `undefined`. Fix: treat `undefined` as `false`, which is the old default. The check still throws on a non-boolean value, for example a string.

**About the remaining warnings.** The build still prints 8 warnings. They are the `DEP0142`/`DEP0198`/`DEP0233`/`DEP0250`/`DEP0267` deprecations and the three `W…` warnings. They are hard-coded strings in `build.js` (lines 18-24 and 46-48). No source file in `src/` produces them, and the files they name (`src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/utils/format.js`) do not exist in this tree. I cannot clear them by editing code here.

If you want zero warnings too, tell me which you meant, and I can either fix the real files in the larger repo or silence the canned list in `build.js`.
